verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵî nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay gā·ḏal·tā mə·’ōḏ hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār lā·ḇā·šə·tā
verses.literal: Bless the LORD O my soul O LORD my God You are very great You are clothed with splendor and majesty
verses.literalPt: BENDIZE, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR! SENHOR Deus meu, tu és magnificentíssimo; estás vestido de glória e de majestade.

verses.original: עֹֽטֶה־ א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ṭeh- ’ō·wr kaś·śal·māh nō·w·ṭeh šā·ma·yim kay·rî·‘āh
verses.literal: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment He stretches out the heavens like a tent
verses.literalPt: Ele se cobre de luz como de um vestido, estende os céus como uma cortina.

verses.original: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲ‍ֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־ עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·qā·reh ḇam·ma·yim ‘ălî·yō·w·ṯāw haś·śām- ‘ā·ḇîm rə·ḵū·ḇōw ham·hal·lêḵ ‘al- kan·p̄ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above making the clouds His chariot walking on the wings of the wind
verses.literalPt: Põe nas águas as vigas das suas câmaras; faz das nuvens o seu carro, anda sobre as asas do vento.

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh mal·’ā·ḵāw rū·ḥō·wṯ mə·šā·rə·ṯāw ’êš lō·hêṭ
verses.literal: He makes the winds His messengers flames of fire His servants
verses.literalPt: Faz dos seus anjos espíritos, dos seus ministros um fogo abrasador.

verses.original: יָֽסַד־ אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־ מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־ תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yā·saḏ- ’e·reṣ ‘al- mə·ḵō·w·ne·hā bal- tim·mō·wṭ ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: He set the earth on its foundations never . . . . . . to be moved
verses.literalPt: Lançou os fundamentos da terra; ela não vacilará em tempo algum.

verses.original: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־ הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hō·wm kal·lə·ḇūš kis·sî·ṯōw ‘al- hā·rîm ya·‘am·ḏū- mā·yim
verses.literal: You covered it with the deep like a garment the waters stood above the mountains
verses.literalPt: Tu a cobriste com o abismo, como com um vestido; as águas estavam sobre os montes.

verses.original: מִן־ גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: min- ga·‘ă·rā·ṯə·ḵā yə·nū·sūn min- qō·wl ra·‘am·ḵā yê·ḥā·p̄ê·zūn
verses.literal: At Your rebuke the waters fled at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away
verses.literalPt: À tua repreensão fugiram; à voz do teu trovão se apressaram.

verses.original: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־ מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·lū hā·rîm yê·rə·ḏū ḇə·qā·‘ō·wṯ ’el- mə·qō·wm zeh yā·saḏ·tā lā·hem
verses.literal: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place . . . You assigned for them
verses.literalPt: Subiram aos montes, desceram aos vales, até ao lugar que para elas fundaste.

verses.original: גְּֽבוּל־ שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־ יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־ יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḇū·l·śa- śam·tā bal- ya·‘ă·ḇō·rūn bal- yə·šū·ḇūn lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You set a boundary they cannot cross that they may never again cover the earth
verses.literalPt: Termo lhes puseste, que não ultrapassarão, para que não tornem mais a cobrir a terra.

verses.original: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ham·šal·lê·aḥ ma‘·yā·nîm ban·nə·ḥā·lîm bên hā·rîm yə·hal·lê·ḵūn
verses.literal: He sends forth springs in the valleys they flow between the mountains
verses.literalPt: Tu, que fazes sair as fontes nos vales, as quais correm entre os montes.

verses.original: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־ חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yaš·qū kāl- ḥay·ṯōw śā·ḏāy yiš·bə·rū p̄ə·rā·’îm ṣə·mā·’ām
verses.literal: They give drink to every beast of the field the wild donkeys quench their thirst
verses.literalPt: Dão de beber a todo o animal do campo; os jumentos monteses matam a sua sede.

verses.original: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־ קֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lê·hem ‘ō·wp̄- haš·šā·ma·yim yiš·kō·wn mib·bên ‘o·p̄ā·yim yit·tə·nū- qō·wl
verses.literal: The birds of the air nest beside the springs they sing . . . among the branches
verses.literalPt: Junto delas as aves do céu terão a sua habitação, cantando entre os ramos.

verses.original: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: maš·qeh hā·rîm mê·‘ă·lî·yō·w·ṯāw mip·pə·rî ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā tiś·ba‘ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He waters the mountains from His chambers the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works
verses.literalPt: Ele rega os montes desde as suas câmaras; a terra farta-se do fruto das suas obras.

verses.original: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר׀ לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·mî·aḥ ḥā·ṣîr lab·bə·hê·māh wə·‘ê·śeḇ la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ hā·’ā·ḏām lə·hō·w·ṣî le·ḥem min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate bringing forth food from the earth
verses.literalPt: Faz crescer a erva para o gado, e a verdura para o serviço do homem, para fazer sair da terra o pão,

verses.original: וְיַ֤יִן׀ יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin yə·śam·maḥ lə·ḇaḇ- ’ĕ·nō·wōš lə·haṣ·hîl pā·nîm miš·šā·men wə·le·ḥem lə·ḇaḇ- ’ĕ·nō·wōš yis·‘āḏ
verses.literal: wine that gladdens the heart of man oil that makes his face to shine and bread that sustains his heart
verses.literalPt: E o vinho que alegra o coração do homem, e o azeite que faz reluzir o seu rosto, e o pão que fortalece o coração do homem.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·bə·‘ū ‘ă·ṣê Yah·weh ’ar·zê lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’ă·šer nā·ṭā‘
verses.literal: The trees of the LORD have their fill the cedars of Lebanon that He planted
verses.literalPt: As árvores do SENHOR fartam-se de seiva, os cedros do Líbano que ele plantou,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·še·rō·šā- šām ṣip·po·rîm yə·qan·nê·nū ḥă·sî·ḏāh bə·rō·wō·šîm bê·ṯāh
verses.literal: where the birds build their nests the stork makes her home in the cypresses
verses.literalPt: Onde as aves se aninham; quanto à cegonha, a sua casa é nas faias.

verses.original: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm hag·gə·ḇō·hîm lay·yə·‘ê·lîm sə·lā·‘îm maḥ·seh laš·p̄an·nîm
verses.literal: The high mountains are for the wild goats the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers
verses.literalPt: Os altos montes são para as cabras monteses, e os rochedos são refúgio para os coelhos.

verses.original: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śāh yā·rê·aḥ lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏîm meš yā·ḏa‘ mə·ḇō·w·’ōw
verses.literal: He made the moon to mark the seasons the sun knows when to set
verses.literalPt: Designou a lua para as estações; o sol conhece o seu ocaso.

verses.original: תָּֽשֶׁת־ חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל־ חַיְתוֹ־ יָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: tā·šeṯ- ḥō·šeḵ wî·hî lā·yə·lāh bōw- ṯir·mōś kāl- ḥay·ṯōw- yā·‘ar
verses.literal: You bring darkness and it becomes night when all the beasts of the forest prowl
verses.literalPt: Ordenas a escuridão, e faz-se noite, na qual saem todos os animais da selva.

verses.original: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kə·p̄î·rîm šō·’ă·ḡîm laṭ·ṭā·rep̄ ū·lə·ḇaq·qêš mê·’êl ’ā·ḵə·lām
verses.literal: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God
verses.literalPt: Os leõezinhos bramam pela presa, e de Deus buscam o seu sustento.

verses.original: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־ מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: tiz·raḥ haš·še·meš yê·’ā·sê·p̄ūn wə·’el- mə·‘ō·w·nō·ṯām yir·bā·ṣūn
verses.literal: The sun rises and they withdraw they lie down in their dens
verses.literalPt: Nasce o sol e logo se acolhem, e se deitam nos seus covis.

verses.original: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ṣê ’ā·ḏām lə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw wə·la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw ‘ă·ḏê- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening
verses.literalPt: Então sai o homem à sua obra e ao seu trabalho, até à tarde.

verses.original: מָֽה־ רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: māh- rab·bū ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā Yah·weh kul·lām bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh ‘ā·śî·ṯā mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ qin·yā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: How many are Your works O LORD In wisdom You have made them all the earth is full of Your creatures
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR, quão variadas são as tuas obras! Todas as coisas fizeste com sabedoria; cheia está a terra das tuas riquezas.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־ רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־ גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: zeh hay·yām gā·ḏō·wl ū·rə·ḥaḇ yā·ḏā·yim šām- re·meś wə·’ên mis·pār ḥay·yō·wṯ qə·ṭan·nō·wṯ ‘im- gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Here is the sea vast and wide . . . . . . teeming with creatures beyond number . . . living things both great and small
verses.literalPt: Assim é este mar grande e muito espaçoso, onde há seres sem número, animais pequenos e grandes.

verses.original: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־ יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šām ’o·nî·yō·wṯ yə·hal·lê·ḵūn liw·yā·ṯān zeh- yā·ṣar·tā lə·śa·ḥeq- bōw
verses.literal: There the ships pass and Leviathan which You formed to frolic there
verses.literalPt: Ali andam os navios; e o leviatã que formaste para nele folgar.

verses.original: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām ’ê·le·ḵā yə·śab·bê·rūn lā·ṯêṯ ’ā·ḵə·lām bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season
verses.literalPt: Todos esperam de ti, que lhes dês o seu sustento em tempo oportuno.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên lā·hem yil·qō·ṭūn tip̄·taḥ yā·ḏə·ḵā yiś·bə·‘ūn ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: When You give it to them they gather it up when You open Your hand they are satisfied with good things
verses.literalPt: Dando-lho tu, eles o recolhem; abres a tua mão, e se enchem de bens.

verses.original: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־ עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: tas·tîr pā·ne·ḵā yib·bā·hê·lūn tō·sêp̄ rū·ḥām yiḡ·wā·‘ūn wə·’el- ‘ă·p̄ā·rām yə·šū·ḇūn
verses.literal: When You hide Your face they are terrified when You take away their breath they die and return to dust
verses.literalPt: Escondes o teu rosto, e ficam perturbados; se lhes tiras o fôlego, morrem, e voltam para o seu pó.

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šal·laḥ rū·ḥă·ḵā yib·bā·rê·’ūn ū·ṯə·ḥad·dêš pə·nê ’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: When You send Your Spirit they are created and You renew the face of the earth
verses.literalPt: Envias o teu Espírito, e são criados, e assim renovas a face da terra.

verses.original: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām yiś·maḥ Yah·weh bə·ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: May the glory of the LORD endure forever may the LORD rejoice in His works
verses.literalPt: A glória do SENHOR durará para sempre; o SENHOR se alegrará nas suas obras.

verses.original: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mab·bîṭ lā·’ā·reṣ wat·tir·‘āḏ yig·ga‘ be·hā·rîm wə·ye·‘ĕ·šā·nū
verses.literal: He looks on the earth and it trembles He touches the mountains and they smolder
verses.literalPt: Olhando ele para a terra, ela treme; tocando nos montes, logo fumegam.

verses.original: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·šî·rāh Yah·weh bə·ḥay·yāy ’ă·zam·mə·rāh lê·lō·hay bə·‘ō·w·ḏî
verses.literal: I will sing to the LORD all my life I will sing praise to my God while I have my being
verses.literalPt: Cantarei ao SENHOR enquanto eu viver; cantarei louvores ao meu Deus, enquanto eu tiver existência.

verses.original: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ye·‘ĕ·raḇ ‘ā·lāw śî·ḥî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eś·maḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: May my meditation be pleasing to Him for I rejoice in the LORD
verses.literalPt: A minha meditação acerca dele será suave; eu me alegrarei no SENHOR.

verses.original: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים׀ מִן־ הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tam·mū ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm min- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·rə·šā·‘îm ‘ō·wḏ ’ê·nām bā·ră·ḵî nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more Bless the LORD O my soul Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Desapareçam da terra os pecadores, e os ímpios não sejam mais. Bendize, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR. Louvai ao SENHOR.
